  • HD Polarized Lenses:All TURBOPEP polarized sunglasses are selected with premium polarized lenses with UV protection.TAC lenses restore true color and reduce eye damage from UVA, UVB and bright light. How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Comfortable, stylish, and great for everyday wear
These sunglasses have been a great purchase! They have a modern look, feel lightweight, and are comfortable enough to wear all day without pinching or sliding around. The plastic material hasn’t let my husband down yet, and he can be tough on things! He favors the blue lenses (see photos). The polarized lenses have a great size to them and they do a great job cutting down glare, especially while driving, boating, or spending time at the lake. Visibility is clear, and they provide excellent sun protection on bright days. I also liked that they came with a protective carrying case and a microfiber cleaning cloth, making it easy to keep them clean and protected when they’re not being worn. The quality feels much better than I expected for the price. Overall, these are an excellent value. If you’re looking for affordable polarized sunglasses that are comfortable, durable, and look great, I’d definitely recommend giving these a try.

    I’ve been buying these every year because they’re lightweight, comfortable, and surprisingly good for the price. The polarized lenses do a great job cutting glare, especially when driving or mowing, and I can wear them all day without them bothering me.

    I included a photo comparing my new blue pair to last year’s. After about a year of regular use, the blue mirror coating started to chip a little. That’s really my only complaint, but considering the price, I don’t mind replacing them annually. I usually end up losing or scratching the other colors before they get that old anyway.

    If you’re looking for an inexpensive pair of polarized sunglasses that are comfortable enough for everyday use, these are hard to beat. They even come with a free cleaning cloth. Just don’t expect the mirrored coating to last forever if you wear them every day.

About this Item

  • HD Polarized Lenses:All TURBOPEP polarized sunglasses are selected with premium polarized lenses with UV protection.TAC lenses restore true color and reduce eye damage from UVA, UVB and bright light. Helps you avoid distractions and temporary blindness caused by glare, and also helps you see brighter scenes and more vibrant colors more clearly
  • Metal Gripper Hinges:Specially designed hinges allow you to adjust the tightness of the frame at will,extending the life of the sunglasses.TURBOPEP is committed to providing consumers with a comfortable sunglasses experience
  • Classic Rectangular Design:Unique cubic square design,low-key but not mediocre,the line design of the temples add a sense of avant-garde movement to the classic fashion.Whether it's a business suit or a casual sweatshirt,TURBOPEP sunglasses can match
  • Outdoor Activity Partner:TURBOPEP sunglasses for men are perfect for outdoor sports such as walking,biking,driving,fishing,traveling,hiking.The lightweight frame and strong metal hinges will ensure that the wearer will not easily fall off even when exercising
  • Thoughtful After-Sales Service:After receiving TURBOPEP sunglasses,please contact us even if you have any product problems,we will solve the problem for you at the first time
